item.title: Ameren Illinois Customers Zapped With Rate Hike
item.description: (Springfield, IL) -- Customers of Ameren Illinois in Fulton County as well as the rest of the service area for the utility company will see a jump in their bills next month, thanks to a 137-million-dollar rate increase approved by the Illinois Commerce Commission. It means the average customer bill will rise between four- and six-dollars a month. The increase was approved under a state law that grants electric utilities a quicker path to rate hikes to get money to improve their electric grid

item.title: Flu Season Coming On Strong
item.description: (Springfield, IL) -- It looks like the flu bug is coming on pretty strong in Fulton County as well as across Illinois this year. Stats from the state health department show more than 100 people have already been admitted into hospital intensive care units for treatment. No deaths have been reported. Officials are urging people to get a flu shot to help keep the bug at bay.

item.title: State Weather Officials Doubtful About White Christmas Chances
item.description: (Undated) -- What are the chances of a white Christmas in Illinois this year? State Climatologist Jim Angel says it depends on where you live. The areas with the highest statistical possibility of a white Christmas are all in Northwestern Illinois, but Angel says the current long-term forecast is calling for above-normal temperatures through Christmas Day.

item.title: Monday Is ACA Plan Enrollment Deadline
item.description: (Undated) -- Today is an important signup deadline under the Affordable Care Act. Health and Human Services Secretary Sylvia Burwell says you must enroll by midnight for your coverage to start January 1st. Burwell says people should report problems with the sign-up websites right away.
